title: Factorization of invariant polynomials and generalized spectral characterizations of graphs
summary: The problem of characterizing graphs by their generalized spectra has received significant attention in recent years. This paper provides a complete proof of a conjecture proposed by Wang, Wang, and Zhu (European J. Combin., 2023), which asserts that the square-root polynomial of the invariant polynomial $Φ_p(G;x) \in \mathbb{F}_p[x]$ can replace its square-free part to yield a more effective criterion for a graph to be determined by its generalized spectrum (DGS).
